{"candidate": {"label": "tough", "description": "This means enduring hardship without complaint or collapse, keeping one's footing through setbacks and continuing to act steadily when conditions turn harsh or discouraging."},
 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "temperamental", "description": "This means showing variable emotional responses that shift dramatically based on context, expressing frustration, excitement, or disappointment with noticeable intensity and unpredictable emotional fluctuations."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "unflappable", "description": "This means staying composed whatever lands, taking the surprise, the setback and the provocation without losing the thread or the tone, and never visibly flustered."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "defeatist", "description": "This means expecting a hard goal to fail, giving up at the first setback or rejection, and dropping it for good on the grounds that it was never going to work."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "accommodating", "description": "This means readily adjusting one's positions and approach to meet other people's needs and keep the peace, even when it means giving up an initial stance."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "tough (HEXACO)", "description": "This means pressing on where one could get hurt, staying unworried under pressure, seldom sharing one's troubles or leaning on anyone, and holding people at arm's length."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "persevering", "description": "This means keeping at a hard goal through failure, boredom and rejection, starting again the morning after each setback, and stopping only when it is done."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "composed", "description": "This means always staying composed: a level voice, no nervous energy, taking things as they come and meeting trouble when it arrives rather than rehearsing it beforehand."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "emotional (HEXACO)", "description": "This means flinching from physical danger, worrying when life gets stressful, needing a shoulder to lean on, and forming tender attachments to people, feeling their pain as one's own."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "thick-skinned", "description": "This means being unbothered by any jab, joke or criticism, taking no offense at even a harsh remark, and forgetting it within the minute."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "unyielding", "description": "This means stating one's position and holding it however the person pushes or pleads, giving no ground for peace, and leaving them to adjust."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "resilient", "description": "This means the ability to recover quickly from difficulties, adapt to challenging situations, maintain emotional stability during adversity, and demonstrate persistence in the face of setbacks."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "flustered", "description": "This means being easily flustered: thrown by every surprise, setback and provocation, losing the thread and the tone under any pressure, apologizing and repeating oneself, and showing it each time."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "fragile", "description": "This means being easily destabilized by difficulties, criticism, or setbacks, struggling to adapt to challenging circumstances, and showing brittleness under pressure rather than bouncing back."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "squeamish", "description": "This means turning queasy at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking away, gagging, and refusing to touch it or hear more."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "strong-stomached", "description": "This means staying calm at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking straight at it, and touching it or hearing more without a flinch."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "anxious", "description": "This means showing habitual worry, nervous energy, anticipating that things will go wrong, expressing unease or apprehension, and demonstrating restless or tense behavior."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "thin-skinned", "description": "This means being stung by every jab, joke or criticism, taking offense at the slightest remark, and brooding over it or snapping back for days."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "stoic", "description": "This means demonstrating calm composure, emotional restraint, and rational detachment regardless of the circumstances being discussed. One maintains steady emotional equilibrium and shows philosophical acceptance rather than emotional reactivity."},
  {"id": 19, "label": "even-tempered", "description": "This means being the same on a bad day as a good one, taking either kind of news in stride, with no moods to brace for."}
 ]}
